description: Run shell commands and Python, and keep files, in this conversation's own scratch folder: no network, nothing outside the folder, and resource limits on every command.
migration_note: Compiled Rust adapters calling the isolated worker's strict sandbox (Landlock with no TCP, a seccomp filter refusing every socket and io_uring call, resource limits and a folder cap). Limits come from limits.json and the storage owner's remaining room.
skill_summary: Build and test small files and scripts in a private scratch folder with sandbox_shell, sandbox_python and sandbox_file.
